{{Quote|The Rebels will see no more use from this communications center&mdash;destroy it!|Darth Vader orders Imperial forces to assault the communications array|<ref name="EAW">''[[Star Wars: Empire at War]]''</ref>}}
The '''Alliance Comms Center''' was a facility<ref name="SoR">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]''</ref> that was constructed<ref name="sw:eaw:imp" /> on the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Thyferra/Legends|Thyferra]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] before it attempted to recapture the world around the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]. After being built, the structure was eventually abandoned and subsequently came into the possession of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]],<ref name="sw:eaw:imp" /> an organization [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|rebelling]] against the Imperial government.<ref name="TEA" /> The Alliance also constructed [[DF.9/Legends|anti-infantry turrets]] near the uplink and maintained a garrison of [[Rebel trooper/Legends|Rebel troopers]] and two [[T2-B Repulsor Tank/Legends|T2-B repulsor tanks]] in close proximity.<ref name="sw:eaw:imp" />

Around 0 BBY, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]],<ref name="sw:eaw:imp" /> the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]],<ref name="TEA" /> [[Assault on Thyferra|invaded]] Thyferra with an Imperial force of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] and [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|All Terrain Scout Transports]] led by a [[Field Commander/Legends|field commander]] in an attempt to rout the treacherous [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kalast]].<ref name="sw:eaw:imp" />
{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: Empire at War}}
The Imperial forces [[Death/Legends|killed]] the Rebels guarding the communications center before destroying the building itself under orders from Vader and continuing with their assault. The Alliance base was eventually ravaged and its garrison neutralized.<ref name="sw:eaw:imp" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The communications center's only appearance so far is in the [[2006]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Empire at War]]''.<ref name="EAW" /> The structure appears in the first mission of the Imperial story campaign and its fate depends on the player's performance; the Imperial forces need to get past two anti-infantry turrets, two T2-B tanks and multiple Rebel troopers to get to the array, which will prompt Vader to order its destruction. If the player does not reach the proximity of the complex, the events mentioned in the article do not take place.<ref name="sw:eaw:imp" />
